author: Discovery
description:
Actor/comedian Ken Jeong uses the power of K-Pop to transform the perception of sharks in East Asia and across the globe in the boundary-pushing K-Pop Shark Heroes during Shark Week. This is the debut of the first, official Shark Week song, “Om-A-Nom (Shark Week)” featuring Ken Jeong. Special appearance by GRAMMY®-nominated artist REI AMI

Don’t miss K-Pop Shark Heroes when #SharkWeek premieres Sunday, July 26 at 8P on Discovery!

author: Discovery
description:
Watch as these explorers track some of the world's most elusive shark species! From the legendary beast of Andros Island in the Bahamas, to Colombia's mysterious Malpelo Monster, is it a giant Galápagos shark or something else?

Stream Full Episodes of Expedition X:
https://www.discoveryplus.com/show/expedition-x

#Discovery #ExpeditionX

About Expedition X:
Explorer Josh Gates has put together a team to undertake investigations delving into realms beyond the "unknown." Jessica Chobot and Phil Torres join his quest to mount unprecedented expeditions into the unexplained and perhaps unexplainable.
